notes: SHIP v1.14.386 - THREE PURPOSE-BUILT SHELLS. Owner device review: the desktop shell was forcing a full three-column Mission Control grid into a laptop viewport. Root cause, measured not guessed: the three-column upgrade was gated at 1200px and then 1280px, but at 1280 a 246px sidebar plus 56px padding leaves 978px of content while three columns need 560+310+300+30 = 1200. The overflow never scrolled - it was CLIPPED by #cmd-shell overflow-x:hidden, which is exactly why it read as cramped panels, a clipped LOCAL SYSTEM STATE title and wrapped values rather than an obviously broken page. PHANTOM now has THREE intentional compositions, not one grid that shrinks: PHONE / Field Mode at 0-850 (single column, bottom nav, approved mockup, untouched by this ship), LAPTOP / Mobile Mission Control at 851-1499 (persistent left nav, ONE dominant workspace, ONE readable context rail at minmax(290px,320px), desktop topbar, no bottom nav, no third column), and DESKTOP / Full Mission Control at 1500+ (three columns, the first width where they genuinely fit). Sidebar is a 82px icon rail to 1099 and full 246px above it, per compact-or-full-by-available-width. FIXES, ALL NINE: (1) sidebar no longer eats the workspace - compact through 1099. (2) the hero dominates: 803x751 at 1440 against a 320px rail. (3) Intelligence and Local System State get the full 320px rail instead of 300 and 270 columns. (4) LOCAL SYSTEM STATE no longer clips - title letter-spacing eased from .17em to .12em and verified with scrollWidth vs clientWidth. (5) card edges align - all three rail cards share identical left and right edges, verified. (6) an empty Build Progress sizes to its sentence via .is-empty instead of holding a 206px slab. (7) the topbar has an inner rail mirroring the content max-width and padding, so the title sits on the hero left edge (274=274) and SCAN on the rail right edge (1252=1252), verified. (8) desktop type is its own scale now, not compressed phone type - panel titles 12.5px, row labels 13px, values 12px, Intelligence title 16.5px, hero 38px at full desktop. (9) the hero stretches to the rail height (align-items:stretch) so the left column has no dead space and the page reads as one environment rather than loose cards. All values remain real local state; nothing in this ship touches data. KNOWN NIT: the five Build Progress step labels truncate in the 320px rail (MECHAN..., VALIDAT...); the count under each is exact. DEVICE-VERIFY: laptop at 1280 and 1440 - two columns, dominant hero, readable rail, aligned topbar, no bottom nav; 1500+ - three columns; phone unchanged; ?legacy=1 unchanged.
